summary: Conservation pledges include protecting 20% of nearshore marine and coastal resources by 2020 and gender-responsive forest-carbon-sink stewardship: 30% women’s representation, 40% higher workshop/campaign participation, 70% consultation input, 60% training/certification and 80% completion by 2025–2026. Training commitments cover 500 women in water management by 2027 and 500 women and youth in sustainable tourism by 2028. Restoration/forestry actions extending to 2030 emphasize REDD+, reforestation, afforestation, sustainable forest management, mangroves and land-degradation neutrality, but state no hectare target, so no share of the country’s 324 km² forest cover (83.3%) can be quantified; agriculture occupies 24 km² (6.2%). Agriculture pledges focus on inclusion rather than acreage: 50–80% platform use, training, insurance coverage or extension-service targeting, a 30% financing increase for women/youth-led initiatives, 100 youth innovators and 20 projects by 2025, and three agri-tech projects by 2028. Mixed pledges support 50 women entrepreneurs, 30 network members and one climate-innovation hub.
